Everyone rejects me saying "improve your English". I have tried YouTube videos, online courses, and even grammar books, but there is no improvement in my English at all.] Speaker B: Ravi sach bataun, tum ye sab time waste karna band karo aur meri tarah kuch effective use karo. [What is this SpeakX app?] Speaker B: Is app mein tum AI teachers ki help se English bolna seekh sakte ho. Aur ye teachers bilkul bhi judge nahi karti. Isse tum interview related kuch bhi pooch sakte ho, jaise ki introduction kaise dete hain, apni hobbies, skills ya strengths kaise batani hai. Main bata rahi hu, roz 10-15 minute is app pe daily practice karna shuru kar do aur phir dekhna, 15-20 dinon mein ekdum fluent English bolne lag jaoge. [In this app, you can learn to speak English with the help of AI teachers. And these teachers do not judge you at all. You can ask them anything related to interviews, like how to introduce yourself, or how to talk about your hobbies, skills, or strengths. I'm telling you, start practicing daily on this app for 10-15 minutes, and then see, you will start speaking fluent English in 15-20 days.] Speaker A: Yaar Shreya, ye AI mehenga hoga na? [But Shreya, this AI must be expensive, right?] Speaker B: Are tum tension mat lo, sirf 4 rupees per day mein 7 din ka trial le sakte ho. [Oh, don't worry, you can get a 7-day trial for just 4 rupees per day.] Speaker A: Are pehle batati na, ruko main abhi download karta hu SpeakX app. [You should have told me earlier! Wait, let me download the SpeakX app right now.]
